what: The first reading this project has taken on any host but PowerPoint on the web.
machine: AITEST, console session, Office Current Channel x64

manifest.source: v0.6.0 release asset, sha-verified byte-identical to the repo copy

insert.chart: the pane default — `stacked`, "Revenue by segment", carrying decorations.cagr {from:0,to:3}
insert.whyThatChart: the CAGR arrow is an arrowhead node, which is exactly what `marksThisHostWillDrop` drops when canRotate() is false — so the default chart is the one that would expose a picture fallback
insert.paneSaid: Scaled to fit the space left on the slide — drag or resize it as you like.

conclusion: Native editable shapes, not a picture, on a current Windows desktop — the claim the store listing makes. Verified with COM rather than from the pane's message, because a picture insert also reports success.
doesNotCover: Mac, which the manifest also claims and which has never been measured.
Volume-licensed/LTSC Windows, where Microsoft lists 1.6 through 1.10 as Not available — this machine cannot represent it and no update reaches it.
Any Windows build below 19610.20002, the 1.10 minimum. This is one host at 20326.20144, i.e. the good tier.
Anything beyond a single insert of one chart kind: no battery, no repeat, n=1.
